svg.title: Web media player and restricted seek
svg.text: Archetype 5 — the web media player, and what “restricted” actually looks like
Chromium native [M2,M4] · YouTube [M9] · video.js [M15] · Plyr [M19] · Media Chrome [M34] · Panopto [T15,T16]
the picture — inert; a click toggles play
buffered shading; the bar always draws
only the CLICK is refused — “users cannot
click on slides … though they can view
A3 across families M and T: 0/12. Restriction locks the control and preserves orientation. Nothing hides the content.
